title: Boone–Higman embeddings with higher finiteness

result.label: Boone–Higman embeddings with higher finiteness
result.statement: A finitely generated group has decidable word problem exactly when it embeds in a finitely presented simple group, proving the Boone–Higman conjecture. The target can have type F ∞ : a classifying space with finitely many cells in each dimension. A single group of type F ∞ can also contain every finitely presented group.
